title: ICICI Bank Ltd — General Updates
text: ICICI Bank Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 read with para A of Schedule III and Regulation 46(2) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
